notice.title: Before you record
notice.intro: This question asks for a spoken answer. Read this once before you start.
notice.purposeLabel: Why we ask for a recording
notice.purposeBody: Your teacher uses your recorded answer to grade this question and to hear how you explain your thinking.
notice.refuseBody: Yes. You can stop a recording and discard it, and nothing is kept or sent.
notice.consequenceBody: The question stays incomplete and the assignment cannot be submitted.
notice.recipientsBody: Your recording is saved to your teacher’s Google Drive under your real name. Your teacher, and school staff who are allowed to see your school records, can listen to it.

capture.title: Spoken answer
capture.prepBody: Plan what you want to say. You can start recording as soon as you are ready.
capture.recordingHint: Recording stops on its own at {{seconds}} seconds.
capture.wrapUp: Wrap it up — recording stops at {{seconds}} seconds.
capture.reviewBody: Nothing has been sent yet. Keep this take, or discard it and record again.
capture.windowClosedBody: The time to record an answer to this question has passed, so there is nothing left to record here. Your teacher will see this question without a recording. Move on when you are ready.
capture.armedBody: When you press record you will have {{seconds}} seconds.
capture.takeLimitReachedBody_one: This question allows {{count}} take, and you have used it. Your last take is the one your teacher receives.
capture.takeLimitReachedBody_other: This question allows {{count}} takes, and you have used them all. Your last take is the one your teacher receives.
capture.submitBlockedTitle_one: One question still needs a recording
capture.submitBlockedBody_one: The question stays incomplete and the assignment cannot be submitted. Go back and record an answer, then turn it in.
capture.submitBlockedBody_other: The questions stay incomplete and the assignment cannot be submitted. Go back and record an answer for each one, then turn it in.
capture.notSubmittedPending: Not yet submitted — your recording is still being sent.
capture.notSubmittedFailed: Not yet submitted — sending your recording did not finish. Nothing is retrying on its own; choose Try again.
capture.notSubmittedFailedFinal: Not yet submitted — sending your recording did not finish, and it can no longer be sent from this device. Record again to send a new take.

unavailable.title: Your microphone did not work
unavailable.body: We could not use a microphone on this device, so there is no recording to send. This question goes to your teacher ungraded, and they will decide what to do about it. Move on to the next question.

authoring.prepHint: Seconds before the recorder arms. 0 starts them ready to record.
authoring.limitHint: Hard stop for one take, up to {{max}} seconds.
authoring.expiryAutoStartHint: The recorder starts on its own.
authoring.expiryAutoAdvanceHint: The quiz moves to the next question.
authoring.expiryArmedHint: The record button stays live until the student presses it.
authoring.expiryUnansweredHint: The slot closes and comes to you ungraded.
authoring.takeLimitHint: A take is a recording the student keeps, not one they discard.
authoring.timeLimitDisabledHint: Disabled — recording questions use their own prep and recording timer instead of the speed bonus.

advisory.title: As authored
advisory.slots_one: Records up to {{count}} slot per student.
advisory.slots_other: Records up to {{count}} slots per student.
advisory.deviceBlocked: If a student's device blocks the microphone, the question comes to you ungraded — you choose whether it's excused, scored zero, or answered another way.
advisory.shuffleNoOp: Question shuffle has no effect here: shared stimuli group every question into one block.

advisory.notSelfPaced: Spoken answers are collected only in self-paced sessions; live sessions will show these questions as written.

grading.title: Freie Antworten bewerten
grading.closeWithFailures: Grades for {{names}} could not be saved. Close anyway and lose them?
grading.discardMessage: You have unsaved grade edits. Discard them?

empty.title: Noch keine freien Antworten zu bewerten
empty.body: Sobald Schüler eine Frage mit freier Antwort beantworten, getippt oder gesprochen, erscheinen sie hier.

takes.title: Takes
takes.pinNote: Scoring always uses the last take. Picking an earlier one records which take your comments are about.

unavailable.title: This student could not record
unavailable.body: Their device could not capture audio, so there is nothing to listen to. Choose how this question counts before the grade is final.
unavailable.excuseHelp: Leave it out of the gradebook entirely.
unavailable.blankHelp: Count it as a zero, like an unanswered question.
unavailable.substituteHelp: You heard the answer another way. A note is required.

player.loadFailed: The recording could not be loaded from your Google Drive. Check that you are still signed in to Google and try again.

archiving.title: Still saving
archiving.body: This take is still being saved to your Google Drive. It becomes playable as soon as that finishes — usually within a few minutes.

archive-failed.title: Not saved
archive-failed.body: Saving this take to your Google Drive did not finish. It retries automatically every hour; nothing is lost in the meantime.

lost.title: Lost
lost.body: Saving this take to your Google Drive failed too many times, so it is no longer being retried and the recording cannot be recovered. The student's other takes and any grade already given still stand.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.body: This recording was deleted for compliance and can no longer be played. Any grade already on it still stands.

unknown.title: Not available
unknown.body: This take cannot be played right now.

errors.noIdentifier: Cannot save: this response is missing its identifier. Reload the quiz results and try again.
errors.chooseOutcome: Choose Excuse, Blank, or Offline substitute before saving.
errors.noteRequired: An offline substitute needs a note — it is the only record of the answer.
errors.emptyAnnotations: Anmerkungen zu einer leeren Antwort können nicht gespeichert werden — der Schüler hat diese Frage nicht beantwortet.

emptyQuestions.title: Dieses Quiz enthält keine Fragen mit freier Antwort
emptyQuestions.body: Manuelle Bewertung ist nur für Fragen mit freier Antwort verfügbar.

grading.noTextAnswer: Der Schüler hat diese Frage nicht beantwortet.
grading.highlightsEmpty: Text auswählen, um ihn zu markieren.
grading.pointsOverrideNote: Nur Punkte für diesen Schüler — Raster außer Kraft gesetzt.
grading.noAnswersOnQuestion: Noch keine Antworten auf diese Frage.

playback.label: Your recorded answer
playback.archiving: Your recording is still being saved. Check back in a few minutes.
playback.failed: Your recording is still being saved — the system keeps trying on its own. Check back later.
playback.deleted: This recording has been deleted and can no longer be played.
playback.missing: There is no recording saved for this question.
playback.tooLarge: This recording is too large to play here. Ask your teacher to play it for you.
playback.provisionalScore: Provisional — your teacher hasn’t graded your recorded answer yet, so this score will change.
playback.lost: Your recording could not be saved and can no longer be recovered. Your teacher can see that you recorded an answer.
playback.commentsHint: Tap a comment to jump to that moment.
playback.scorePending: Your score is being prepared. Check back soon.
